items: Two flights back to back around a landing — the usual stair in a Dutch stairwell. steps is the TOTAL; the stair is steps x rise tall.
A straight flight, a quarter (turn degrees) of winder treads, then the second flight. The winders are approximated by rotated treads.
A single landing slab: w across, d deep, t thick, top face at t.

Four shaft walls, open at the top. w x d is the OUTSIDE of the shaft, h is the full height over every storey it serves. A shaft placed by hand has no doors and no overrun: doors is the list of storeys served, sh the storey height, door_side the face they open onto — add_elevator fills all three and cuts the floor openings.
The car inside the shaft. door = 1 leaves the +X face open (doors that side), door = 0 closes it.
A sloping truss with two balustrades. The horizontal run follows from the rise and the pitch: rise / tan(angle).
An external switchback: one straight flight plus a landing per storey, alternating direction. Height = storeys x h.
